request: Analyze GSE227516 for PMID 39317751 (Exercise activates AMPK in mouse and human pancreatic islets to decrease senescence.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NovaSeq 6000) of isolated pancreatic islets
final.samples: male C57BL/6 mice, 6-9 months old, n = 5 sedentary and n = 5 treadmill-trained (1 h/day, 10 days) (Fig. 2j,k legend; Fig. 4c,d legend)
final.inclusion: all 10 deposited samples; no exclusions stated
final.primary_estimand: effect of 10-day treadmill endurance training versus sedentary on islet gene expression in male C57BL/6 mice (causal, randomized intervention between independent animals)
planned_contrasts: trained vs sedentary (S1.3.p1, Fig. 2j,k; S1.5.p2, Fig. 4c,d; paper reports no DEG count)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S3.15.1.p1 (analysis done by Joslin core, no method or threshold); S3.23.p1 (P < 0.05 is for GraphPad physiology/qPCR statistics, not RNA-seq)

final.paper_method: not stated (Joslin Bioinformatics and Biostatistics Core; GEO data_processing: kallisto + tximport gene counts)
final.paper_results: gene-set level only: SenMayo senescence set reduced (violin + heatmap, Fig. 2j,k); glucagon signalling / GCGR-activation genes a top upregulated pathway (Fig. 4c,d, S1.5.p2). No DEG list or count in the text.

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Results S1.3.p1 and the Fig. 2j,k and Fig. 4c,d legends define the RNA-seq comparison: islets from sedentary vs treadmill-trained 6-9-month-old male C57BL/6 mice, n = 5 per group. Methods S3.15.1.p1 gives no DE method or threshold; the only stated threshold (S3.23.p1, P < 0.05) belongs to the Prism analyses of physiology and qPCR. DA.p1 names GSE227516.

checks: GEO: pancreatic islet, Mus musculus, C57Bl/6, male, 5 SEDENTARY + 5 EXERCISE, matching the paper's n = 5 per group
contact is the Joslin Bioinformatics and Biostatistics Core, the group the paper names as doing the analysis

ownership.reasoning: The accession, tissue, strain, sex and group sizes all match the paper's RNA-seq cohort.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns P1..P10 are the first token of the GEO title (inspect alignment_keys: title contains the name, 10/10). Group is the second title token, identical to characteristics treatment.

final.source: GEO data_processing: kallisto (Ensembl 104) transcript counts converted to gene counts with tximport

matrix.reasoning: 87% integer values, max 2.7e6, library sums 15-23 M, Ensembl gene IDs; data_processing states kallisto + tximport gene counts, so these are estimated counts (non-integer), not TPM. Rounding before a count model is the standard tximport recipe (DESeqDataSetFromMatrix on round(counts)).

design.reasoning: One factor with two levels, independent animals, n = 5 per arm; the paper compares trained with sedentary (S1.3.p1). Only male samples, so no sex split.

covariance.reasoning: One islet sample per animal; no batch, litter or sequencing-run column in GEO; all samples male and the same strain and age range.

paper_route.reason: paper gives no RNA-seq DE method (S3.15.1.p1)

deviations: DE method chosen by the workflow because the paper states none; estimated counts rounded to integers before DESeq2

method.reasoning: Estimated counts from tximport support a negative-binomial count model after rounding (the tximport/DESeq2 recipe). The paper names no method, so DESeq2 ~ grp is the workflow choice.

final.deviation_note: No RNA-seq threshold in the paper; workflow default BH padj < 0.05, no fold-change rule. Raw p < 0.05 is reported only as a labelled audit count.

threshold.reasoning: S3.15.1.p1 states no threshold; S3.23.p1's P < 0.05 applies to Prism statistics, not RNA-seq.

caveats: Paper reports RNA-seq only at gene-set level (SenMayo down, glucagon/GCGR signalling up); no DEG count to compare.
Gene lookups Cdkn1a/Cdkn2a come from qPCR in other cohorts of the paper (Fig. 1-2), not from this RNA-seq; Gcgr is from Fig. 4c heatmap.

Direction contradiction: Cdkn1a (p21Cip1) is UP in our RNA-seq result (log2FC +0.70, padj 0.042), whereas the paper reports exercise lowering p21Cip1 by qPCR in other cohorts (Fig. 2d, Fig. 4b). Cdkn2a is down but not significant (padj 0.33).

Glucagon signalling: Gcgr log2FC +0.97 is in the paper's direction but not significant (padj 0.24); KEGG Glucagon signaling pathway is not enriched by ORA (adj P 0.35), so the paper's 'top upregulated pathway' claim (S1.5.p2) is not reproduced with this threshold and gene-set library.
SenMayo gene set (paper Fig. 2j) is not in the workflow libraries and was not tested; KEGG Cellular senescence is over-represented among DEGs (adj P 0.001) without direction.

study.reasoning: Method and threshold are workflow choices because the paper states neither; the contrast and sample set match the paper.

executions.name: grp_EX_vs_SED
executions.reasoning: trained vs sedentary, DESeq2 ~ grp on rounded estimated counts

enrichment.reasoning: paper reports pathway-level results (glucagon signalling up, senescence set down, S1.5.p2, Fig. 2j)
